name: idos-mcp-server
description: Czech train, bus and city transport connections, departure boards and timetables from IDOS.cz. Read-only.
long_description: Lets Claude plan journeys on Czech public transport, show departure and arrival boards with platforms and live delays, look up the full route of a train by its number, and read city-line timetables for Prague, Brno and about 90 other cities, all from IDOS.cz. It only reads timetables: it cannot buy tickets, make reservations or access any account.
